title: Goldman Sachs CEO backs CLARITY Act, says it would advance crypto market
summary: Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon supports the CLARITY Act, saying it would help guide the crypto market’s appropriate development by creating a fair competitive environment, CoinDesk reported. In an interview with Politico, Solomon said the bill was not perfect and remained open to debate, but would still support orderly market growth.CoinDesk said Solomon’s comments came as amendments to the CLARITY Act were submitted ahead of a U.S. Senate floor vote. The move contrasts with opposition to the bill from major banking executives including JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, according to CoinDesk.The CLARITY Act is centered on clarifying the respective jurisdictions of the U.S. SEC and the CFTC in crypto regulation.

title: Glassnode says BTC selling pressure has largely eased as macro backdrop improves
summary: BTC has posted relative strength for a second straight week, holding up better than U.S. and European equities despite a negative backdrop from a recent surge in international oil prices tied to geopolitical risks involving Iran, on-chain analytics firm Glassnode said in a report.Glassnode said the price gain despite adverse factors suggests market selling pressure has largely been absorbed. The firm added the macroeconomic backdrop also appears to be improving, with U.S. inflation slowing for the first time in five months. Ahead of next week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting, benchmark interest rates still remain restrictive at more than one percentage point above core inflation, Glassnode said. If the Federal Reserve signals the possibility of rate cuts, that could create a favorable macro environment for Bitcoin, it added.
